meta_training: fold4 only, all candidates and baseline matched; checkpoint selected on fold4 then meta fit fold4; scoring exclusively fold0
admission: RTD joint stack must beat incumbent fold0 by >=0.00005 and clean joint stack by >=0.00001; approximate paired95CI lower>0 vs incumbent. No test prediction before admission. This is historical conditional screening not fresh blind or end-to-end nested CV.
inputs: 21 raw per-value embeddings; four periodic numeric; 28-field recomputed row summary; 17-field recomputed numeric summary; no original-label features or public predictions in network; no original author nine-feature-per-field side pipe
transductive: unsupervised vocab/scaling/RTD uses train/test/original features; no labels; RTD target denotes replacement operation including same-value draws
